title: Sequencing self-calibration: why four forms failed, and a fifth
set_out: Finish the derivation and commissioning list: the hairpin genotypes, the control-gain optimum, the temperature prediction, sequencing self-calibration, the qubit derivations and the M-number paper outline.
open_at_turnover: The fifth self-calibration form's synthetic; the hairpin genotype comparison; the temperature prediction sealed; the qubit derivations and the M-number paper outline.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Self-calibration synthetic, fifth form
entries.what: The same 15 planted rows as the first four forms, the library's end-error rates measured where the found cells agree on the atlas.
entries.outcome: Not met: end errors absorbed in 3 of 9; plant visible; a uniform change kept 2 of 3. The rates themselves were measured exactly; the library's own end error differs between site sets in two of three laboratories.

entries.title: Self-calibration, fifth form
entries.what: The library's two molecule-end error rates measured where every found cell agrees on the atlas, put into the mixed forward model (stage_metaa_atlas.agree_rates, run_sample.py --dev-seq-self-cal-agree); its synthetic sealed before reading, the same 15 rows and bars as the first four.
entries.outcome: Checked on a simulated library on the atlas's own columns before sealing: both planted rates recovered.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: Why the first four self-calibration forms failed
entries.what: Each measured the library's end error on sides set by the read cell's own level at its identity sites, where the other cells of a mix hold the opposite state.
entries.outcome: The measured rate is a blend of both errors for a minority cell; the measurement of each planted error itself was right.

entries.title: A library's molecule-end error depends on the site set
entries.what: In the B-cell and CD4 laboratories the end error at the read cell's identity sites differs from that at sites every cell holds alike.
entries.outcome: One rate per library is not enough; the next form measures the rates on the cell's own sites.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes, and what caught each

entries.title: The fifth form's first rule found no sites
entries.what: The agreement rule required every found cell to hold an atlas value; a provisional cell's column is missing at most array sites.
entries.outcome: Caught by the one-row canary before the other rows ran; the rule made share-weighted.

entries.title: Two machine loops lost their connection unnoticed
entries.what: The relaunch watcher and the GitHub filler logged only connection errors for about eleven hours; the half-hour checks read their last line only.
entries.outcome: Both restarted with fresh logs; the loop check now reports a loop whose last six cycles all failed.
